name: [Battle Speed] Cardborn RNG
desc:
🃏 Cardborn RNG 🃏

🎁 Use code !CORRUPTION and !NIGHTMARE for a special reward!

ROLL THE NEW CORRUPTED CARDS AND DEFEAT THE CORRUPTED KING!


🌟 Welcome to Cardborn RNG, a fast-paced, strategy-infused card battler 🌟

Collect unique cards, each forged with powerful abilities and increasing rarity. Roll, assemble  teams, and enter battles. Climb the ranks, flex your rarest pulls, and uncover hidden legacies.

🎴 Hundreds of Unique Cards – Unlock  shiny and awakened variants with rare abilities

🎲 Roll-to-Win Mechanics – Test your luck with every roll

⚔️ PvP & NPC Battles – Face off against real players or story-based enemies in tactical card fights

🧠 Strategic Deck Building – Build, upgrade, and optimize your team for every challenge

🏆 Live Leaderboards – Compete for the top spot in rarest rolls and best teams

🧪 Artifacts & Potions – Equip game-changing relics and consumables to boost your odds and performance
